body:
[Erowid Note: 
The dose described in this report is very high, potentially beyond Erowid's 'heavy' range, and could pose serious health risks or result in unwanted, extreme effects. Sometimes extremely high doses reported are errors rather than actual doses used.]
I received a gram of 5-meo-DALT many months ago and have ran multiple experiments with it. All of the trials were with dosages less than 100mg, which produced a nice psychedelic body high, along with very very mild visuals and mind alterations. I like to think I am experienced with research chemicals. I've tried 2c-i, 2c-e, 2c-p (separate and mixed) JWH-018, MDAI, bk-MDMA, 4-aco-DMT and finally 5-meo-DALT. I will now report on my most recent and successful experience with 5-meo-DALT.
It was a Wednesday and the first night of Fall Break for our university. About 8 close friends from high school and I decided to go camping on my best friend's private land before it got too cold. After packing and getting ready, I pulled out my Bose headphone drug case. I was looking at the bag of -DALT and noticed it was running low, I weighed it out and turned out to be 250 mg. I began looking through the rest of the case and saw that my bk-MDMA was also low at 325 mg. I had not used any of the two in some time. So, I decided to finish em both off and capped them.
- 8:30 PM -
Got to our campsite and got a fire going.
- 9:30 -
After playing some music around the camp fire, I decided to ingest the capsule and start my night.
- 10:15 -
I start to notice the first effects of the bk-MDMA. My body felt light and warm and I was smiling.
- 10:30 -
Tingling sensations start to develop.
- 10:45 -
Okay, I'm wired now and am definitely rolling. I also and starting to feel psychedelic at the same time.
NOTE: I have taken lower doses of -DALT and MDAI at the same time and they didn't quite mix. I could feel one's effect and 30 minutes later the other would take over. This cycle would continue throughout the experience. -DALT and bk-MDMA is quite different. They mix wonderfully in my opinion.
- 11:00 -
Take a hit of nitrous.. haha CRAZY. Since this point visuals started to develop. The first noticed visual was the sparks from the fire. They were flying in directions like one of those fire works that just spin up in the air in random directions.
- 11:15 -
Smoke out a tent with a 1 gram nug blunt between 5 people. Now I'm high.. everything is mixed, hard to tell what is going on.
- 11:45 -
Started peaking off of bk-MDMA, a couple of females came over. I was connecting well and basically rolling nuts. Couldn't sit down.
keep on hitting more nitrous
- 12:15 AM -
This is when 5-meo-DALT showed me it's true potential. Basically, before this night I had only experienced ONE visual off of DALT; which was a piece of metal and breathed for around 10 seconds and looked shiny. However, with 250 mg the visuals were actually quite intense. The grass surrounding our campsite was growing and dancing, waving its arms at me. Colors were amazing! Hues of blue, purple, violet and red were prominent; not at the same time but throughout the night.
- 12:45 -
The peak of bk-MDMA had ended and I was now on the comedown, while at the same time I was starting to trip even harder so.
- 1:15 -
Everyone but my good friend H was only drinking and smoking that night. He had taken a capsule containing 50 mg MDAI and 50 mg 5-meo-DALT which I intended to take, but never got around to it. He took his an hour or so after I did and reported a 15 minute span of minor visuals.
- 1:45 -
Okay, now I have tripped a lot in my days off of both scheduled and unscheduled drugs. I have had mind fucks and am used to them, but for some reason I felt unprepared for this one because I had not expected one to even develop. It did however. I couldn't keep any conversations going with the females that were there and most people were starting to fall asleep. So, they left and the remainder of us decided to smoke another blunt in order for my best friend to fall asleep, so I could ease my mind and for my friend H to simply get high.
- 2:15 -
Best friend falls asleep and it is now only H and myself around the campfire. H has been to rehab and I, myself attended AA for almost a year. So, most times that we trip we also talk about addiction and how our lives are going. I decide to differ from the subject to reduce the chances of a mental breakdown.
We are looking out into the galaxy. I try to explain to him the visuals I am seeing, but he just isn't quite on my level.
Stars were moving in patterns and flashing in a certain orders (almost like a code, but I didn't get any message from it or anything). I notice that there is one light that is much brighter than the other. I turned off my phone hours ago, but decided to google what I was seeing. Turns out that the supposed star was actually the planet Jupiter. It really tripped me out. I focused on Jupiter for long enough that I could see its rings and stars began forming around it.
- 3:15 -
We asked a question we have tried answering while tripping many times before Why do I trip? I can easily answer this sober, but for some reason it always puts me in a mind fuck and it did. I came up with an idea that probably isn't original, but was something I had never thought of.
IDEA: Trips are like forming circles, eventually they always lead me to the exact same spot that I began with. As the day after continues, I lose track of the things I thought about which makes me anticipate the next trip so I can re-learn the answers. Over time and countless trips, they begin to overlap. It wasn't noticeable to me after the 3rd or 4th time tripping... but after, let's say 15 times, the trips began to always give me a mind fuck and always be more intense (even if a lesser amount or less intense substance was taken). So, my theory is: During the peak of every trip, I pick up where my last trip left off, which is the reason why every trip of mine creates a more intense mind fuck, but also allows me to take more answers and meaning of the experience into my normal life.
- 3:45 -
The mind fuck wears off, but I then experienced the most intense visual I've had off of 5-meo-DALT.
Bear with me for the long descriptions So, I have experience with N,N-DMT and will now describe a visual I got after the peak of smoking it to compare it to the visual off of 5-meo-DALT.
N,N-DMT - right after I peaked and could manage to see the world with my eyes open I went straight to the bathroom. I sat down and stared into this red fuzzy rug. Each bundle of fur was growing in fractals and spinning from normal size bundles into smaller and smaller ones into each other in what seemed like 100 different places and 10 different directions.
5-meo-DALT - If you can grasp that description, try to imagine that in the clouds. I was staring at the moon and there were clouds surrounding it. The clouds were swirling in almost a thick arrow shape, growing smaller through fractals; swirling closer and closer to the center of the moon, while changing colors and stars so bright. There were around 12 of these arrow-cloud structures moving into each other and the moon at one time. It really made me happy :) I stared at this visual for around 30 minutes on and off, it was really amazing to me!
- 4:30 -
Visuals slow down Brain feels like scrambled eggs! It was throbbing and hurt.
- 5:00 -
Smoke a bowl and take a sleeping pill.
- 6:00 -
Still tripping but manage to fall asleep.
- 10:30 -
Wake up, very minor visuals and head feels much better :)
Try to eat some chips but found my self chewing the same 3 chips for longer than a minute.
Conclusion: LOVED THE TRIP! I am truly amazed by the experience.
GOOD LUCK :D
